mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the straightening muscles was most worthwhile because the final comparison connected both muscle pulls to opposite elbow movements.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding cartilage was less clear: the compression arrows showed what happened but left me unsure how the cartilage helps.

surprise.text: I was surprised that joint fluid also helps nourish cartilage because cartilage has no blood vessels of its own.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the parts and goals gave each one a clear purpose, though most steps had only one offered combination.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: seeing the separate parts become a working joint was interesting, especially the explanation of opposing pulls.
